content: {"episode_id":"ep-05021","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229), denied under CO-197 for missing authorization. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting."}
